title: Sale of Hobart International Airport Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: As part of the 2007-08 state budget announced on 7 June 2007, the Tasmanian Government decided to sell Hobart International Airport Pty Limited, a subsidiary of the Tasmanian Ports Corporation Pty Limited. The successful bidder was the Tasmanian Gateway Consortium.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a view in relation to market definition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC did not consider that the acquisition would be likely to give rise to any competition issues.
